sloka: विज्ञाय कर्म तत्तेषां रामो लक्ष्मणमब्रवीत् ।प्रेषयस्व द्रुतं दूतान् सुग्रीवाय महात्मने ।। ७.९१.९ ॥
transliteration: vijñāya karma tatteṣāṁ rāmo lakṣmaṇamabravīt ।preṣayasva drutaṁ dūtān sugrīvāya mahātmane ।। 7.91.9 ॥

translations.english: Having understood their decision, Rama then said to Lakshmana, "Send messengers quickly to the great-souled Sugriva."
